s: This article explores Git's non-linear capabilities, focusing on branching and cherry-picking to manage code timelines and experiment safely. It also details refactoring the `Pipulate` Python class for better state management, timestamp handling, and code consistency based on LLM feedback.
sub: Git branching and cherry-picking for non-linear workflows
Refactoring Python `Pipulate` class for code consistency
LLM-assisted code review and refactoring techniques
State management and timestamp handling in Python classes
